summary: You can now create and manage access packages in PIM Manager without touching your existing groups.

new.title: Create access packages in PIM Manager
new.text: Use Create > Access package to make one, then list, view, pause or resume it. Packages also show in the Access map.

new.title: Each package gets its own new groups
new.text: Every package gets new groups ending in -AP, locked to it. Your existing groups are never touched, and a package pauses if anything is unclear.

fixes.title: No orphan-group mails for new installs
fixes.text: An install with no definitions yet no longer sends orphan-group warnings. Its groups show as not imported yet.
